full_judgment:
2. Short facts necessary for disposal of this petition for leave to appeal are that the petitioners as plaintiffs instituted Other Class Suit No.184 of 1999 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Pabna for declaration of title to the inn land stating, inter-alia, that the suit land was purchased by plaintiff No.1 and one Sokiruddin by kabala dated 07.12.1955 from its owner and in the S.A. Khatian their names were recorded to the extent of 22 decimals of land instead of 26 decimals. Sokiruddin transferred 13 decimals of land to plaintiff Nos. 2 and 3 by sale dated 05.12.1948. Plaintiff' Nos. 2 and 3 sold .0375 acre of land to plaintiff No. 4 by a kabala dated 23.11.1996. The plaintiffs have been possessing 26 decimals of from the middle of the suit plot by excluding 34 decimals of land from the northern side. In R.S. operation, the land was recorded in their names in R.S. plot No.2274 but not in the northern side of the previous plot. The plaintiffs by amending the plaint stated that the ex-landlord of the suit land was Tarash Estate which after evicting its tenants gave 32 decimals of land by patton which was demarcated by the surveyor of Tarash Acquired Estate. Abdul Mannan filed Other Class Suit No. 25 of 1954 (no name of the Court is available from the record) for recovery of khas possession in which he got decree. 

 3. The defendant Government contested the suit by filing written statement contending, inter-alia, that the suit land was the excess khas land of the ex-landlord as bazaar and the some vested in the Government after the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act came into being. The suit land is within the periphery of Dhulauri hat. The plaintiffs filed the suit by creating some forged documents and as such, the same was liable to be dismissed.
